# Shopify Product Exporter — Full Technical Context & API Documentation

> **Official Website**: https://shopify-exporter.exnta.com  
> **Chrome Web Store**: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/shopify-scraper-product-e/aifdhpcplonalnbekfigeicngldilgcc  
> **Developer**: Exnta (https://exnta.com)  
> **Category**: E-Commerce Tools / Web Scraping Extensions / Data Migration  

---

## 1. Executive Summary

**Shopify Product Exporter** is a free, high-performance Google Chrome browser extension that enables Shopify store owners, dropshippers, market analysts, and developers to extract full product catalogs from any Shopify-powered website with a single click.

Unlike traditional cloud-based scrapers or SaaS data extractors, Shopify Product Exporter operates **100% locally within the user's browser sandbox**. All network fetching, data parsing, inventory calculation, variant mapping, and file encoding occur on the local machine without routing catalog data through external third-party servers.

---

## 2. Core Capabilities & Feature Matrix

- **1-Click Automatic Store Scraping**: Instantly parses storefront metadata, window objects, and public API endpoints (`/products.json`, `/collections/*.json`) to extract products without requiring Shopify admin access or API keys.
- **Automatic Pagination Handling**: Automatically paginates through large store catalogs containing thousands of products without dropping rows or truncating lists.
- **Multi-Format Data Export**:
  - **CSV (UTF-8)**: Formatted strictly according to official Shopify CSV import schema rules for seamless 1-click re-import into Shopify, WooCommerce, or Google Sheets.
  - **Excel (.xlsx)**: Generates multi-tab workbooks featuring styled headers, automatic column width fitting, freeze panes, and separate Variant vs Product master worksheets.
- **Full Variant & Inventory Extraction**: Captures every individual product variant, including variant-specific pricing, compare-at prices, unique SKUs, stock quantities, weight metrics (grams), and variant-to-image ID bindings.
- **Bulk Image Downloader**: Throttled batch image downloader that extracts and saves high-resolution product photos locally, featuring smart auto-renaming (`[product-handle]-[variant-sku]-[index].webp`).
- **Interactive Filtering Dashboard**: Includes virtual-scrolling data table handling 50,000+ rows smoothly. Supports multi-column filtering by Vendor, Product Type, Price Range, Tags, and Collection.
- **Rate-Limit & Anti-Blocking Protection**: Includes a built-in "Slow Mode" rate limiter to prevent IP throttle triggers on large store audits. Runs directly from residential client IPs.

---

## 3. Extracted Data Field Dictionary

The extension extracts over 25+ granular product data fields per item:

| Field Name | Data Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Handle` | String | URL slug identifier of the product (e.g., `mens-cotton-tshirt`) |
| `Title` | String | Full title of the product |
| `Body (HTML)` | String | HTML formatted rich description, including embedded media tags |
| `Vendor` | String | Brand, store, or manufacturer name |
| `Type` | String | Product category or type (e.g., `Footwear`, `Accessories`) |
| `Tags` | String | Comma-separated list of marketing and organization tags |
| `Published` | Boolean | Publication status (`true` / `false`) |
| `Option1 Name` | String | Primary variant option dimension (e.g., `Size`) |
| `Option1 Value` | String | Primary option value (e.g., `Large`) |
| `Option2 Name` | String | Secondary variant option dimension (e.g., `Color`) |
| `Option2 Value` | String | Secondary option value (e.g., `Black`) |
| `Option3 Name` | String | Tertiary variant option dimension (e.g., `Material`) |
| `Option3 Value` | String | Tertiary option value (e.g., `100% Cotton`) |
| `Variant SKU` | String | Stock Keeping Unit code |
| `Variant Grams` | Integer | Product weight measured in grams |
| `Variant Price` | Decimal | Active selling price in store currency |
| `Variant Compare At Price` | Decimal | Original MSRP or pre-discount price |
| `Variant Requires Shipping` | Boolean | Shipping requirement flag |
| `Variant Taxable` | Boolean | Sales tax flag |
| `Variant Barcode` | String | UPC, EAN, or ISBN barcode number |
| `Image Src` | URL String | Primary high-resolution CDN image URL |
| `Image Position` | Integer | Order index of the image in gallery |
| `Image Alt Text` | String | Alternative text attribute for image SEO |
| `Variant Image` | URL String | Direct image URL tied to specific variant selection |

---

## 4. Replatforming & Target Ecosystem Compatibility

Data exported via Shopify Product Exporter can be directly imported into leading e-commerce platforms:

1. **Shopify to Shopify Migration**: Directly compatible with Shopify's native CSV import wizard (`Admin > Products > Import`).
2. **Shopify to WooCommerce**: Supports WooCommerce Product CSV Import/Export plugin mapping without manual column renaming.
3. **Shopify to BigCommerce / Wix / Square**: Standardized fields allow instant CSV field mapping for catalog transfers.
4. **Google Sheets & Excel Analytics**: Native UTF-8 encoding prevents special character corruption ($ symbols, accents, foreign alphabets).

## 6. Plans & Pricing

- **Core Plan (Free Tier)**:
  - Price: $0.00 / forever
  - Features: 1-click scraping, CSV export, basic search/filter, 100% local processing.
  - Limit: 100 products per scraping session.
- **Pro Plan (Unlimited)**:
  - Price: $3.99 / month (or $39.90 / year, save 17%).
  - Features: Unlimited product exports, Excel (.xlsx) export, bulk image downloader, full variant SKU & stock parsing, slow mode rate-limiter, priority email support.

---

## 7. Security, Privacy & Compliance

- **100% Local Sandbox**: All JavaScript parsing and file generation run inside Chrome's V8 engine on the user's computer. Zero product data, store URLs, or scrape histories are transmitted to Exnta or third-party servers.
- **Permissions**: Requires only `activeTab` and `storage` browser permissions. No background background network proxies or tracking scripts.
- **GDPR & Privacy Compliance**: Collects zero personal tracking data, zero cookies, and zero analytics telemetry.
